name: spacescans-web
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'cp -n .env.docker.example .env || true; grep -q change-me-to-a-real-secret .env && sed -i "s/^SECRET_KEY=.*/SECRET_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)/" .env; if [ -n "$CODESPACE_NAME" ] && ! grep -q ^NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https .env; then sed -i "s|^NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=.*|NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://${CODESPACE_NAME}-8000.${GITHUB_CODESPACES_PORT_FORWARDING_DOMAIN}|" .env; fi; true'
